# Card: `jl-card`

A flat surface for one subject: heading, content, media, actions and a footer.

- Class `JlCard`, a molecule: `import { JlCard } from '@syware/jlib';`
- On the site: https://bioleyl.github.io/jlib/components/card

A card groups what is about one subject: a heading and a description, the content in the default slot,
buttons in slot="actions" (top right) or slot="footer", and a picture in slot="media" (edge to edge, on top). It is
flat, a surface with a line around it; parts with nothing in them leave no gap.

With href the whole card is a link named by its heading; the actions and the footer stay pressable on their own.
With interactive (and no href), the card can be focused and fires press. Keep other buttons out of an interactive
card: screen readers read it as one button. padding="none" leaves the body edge to edge, for a list or a table.

## Use

```ts
import { JlButton, JlCard } from '@syware/jlib';
```

```tsx
<JlCard description="Sent every Monday at 9:00" heading="Weekly report">
  Revenue, sign-ups and churn for the past seven days.
  <JlButton slot="actions" variant="ghost" size="sm" icon="settings" hint="Settings" />
  <JlButton slot="footer" label="Preview" />
  <JlButton slot="footer" variant="primary" label="Send now" />
</JlCard>
```

```html
<jl-card
  description="Sent every Monday at 9:00"
  heading="Weekly report"
>
  Revenue, sign-ups and churn for the past seven days.
  <jl-button slot="actions" variant="ghost" size="sm" icon="settings" hint="Settings"></jl-button>
  <jl-button slot="footer" label="Preview"></jl-button>
  <jl-button slot="footer" variant="primary" label="Send now"></jl-button>
</jl-card>
```

## Properties

Inputs: a JSX prop sets one, code calls `.set(value)` and `.get()`, HTML writes the attribute (lists and objects as JSON).

- `heading` (attribute `heading`): `string`, default `''`. The title.
- `description` (attribute `description`): `string`, default `''`. A line under the heading.
- `padding` (attribute `padding`): `'none' | 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg'`, default `'md'`. The room around the content; none leaves the body edge to edge.
- `interactive` (attribute `interactive`): `boolean`, default `false`. Focusable, with a blue border under the pointer; fires press.
- `href` (attribute `href`): `string`, default `''`. Makes the whole card a link, named by its heading.

## Events

In JSX, the `on…` prop, its handler given the detail; in code, `events.register(name, (detail) => …)`. They do not bubble.

- `press` (`onPress` in JSX), detail `undefined`: An interactive card was pressed (not on a control inside it).

## Slots

- The default slot: The content.
- `media`: A picture or a banner, edge to edge on top.
- `actions`: Buttons at the top right, beside the heading.
- `footer`: Buttons or a note under a line, at the bottom.

## Methods

- `focus(options?: FocusOptions): void`: Focuses the card, or its link when it has an href.

## Styling

- `base` (part, `::part(base)`): The card.
- `--radius` (custom property): The corner radius.

## Examples

HTML as the site renders it, with its layout classes (`row`, `stack`, `narrow`, `muted`), which are not jlib's: a view writes the same components by class in JSX. A script's `root` is the example's element.

### Heading and content

```html
<jl-card class="narrow" heading="Weekly report" description="Sent every Monday at 9:00">
  Revenue, sign-ups and churn for the past seven days, with the changes since the week before.
</jl-card>
```

### A profile

An avatar, badges and buttons: a member of a team.

```html
<jl-card class="narrow">
  <jl-button slot="actions" variant="ghost" size="sm" icon="ellipsis" hint="More"></jl-button>
  <div class="stack">
    <div class="row">
      <jl-avatar size="xl" name="Margaret Hamilton" status="online"></jl-avatar>
      <div>
        <strong>Margaret Hamilton</strong>
        <div class="muted">Lead engineer · Boston</div>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="row">
      <jl-badge tone="accent" label="Admin"></jl-badge>
      <jl-badge tone="ok" label="Verified" icon="check"></jl-badge>
      <jl-badge label="Flight software"></jl-badge>
    </div>
  </div>
  <jl-button slot="footer" label="Message" icon="message"></jl-button>
  <jl-button slot="footer" variant="primary" label="View profile"></jl-button>
</jl-card>
```

### Link and interactive

With href, the whole card is a link: try the keyboard. With interactive, it fires press.

```html
<div class="row" style="align-items: stretch">
  <jl-card style="flex: 1 1 220px" href="#/components/card" heading="Getting started" description="Install jlib and write your first page.">
    <div slot="media" style="height: 120px; background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--jl-accent-soft), var(--jl-surface-3))"></div>
  </jl-card>
  <jl-card class="demo-pick" style="flex: 1 1 220px" interactive heading="Pro plan" description="For growing teams: $24 per seat.">
    <span class="muted demo-picked">Press to choose.</span>
  </jl-card>
</div>
```

```js
const card = root.querySelector('.demo-pick');
card.events.register('press', () => {
  root.querySelector('.demo-picked').textContent = 'Chosen ✓';
});
```

### Padding

none for an edge-to-edge body; sm, md (the default) and lg for the room around the content.

```html
<div class="row" style="align-items: stretch">
  <jl-card padding="sm" heading="Small">12 pixels around.</jl-card>
  <jl-card heading="Medium">20 pixels around.</jl-card>
  <jl-card padding="lg" heading="Large">28 pixels around.</jl-card>
</div>
```

### With an empty state

An empty state inside a card, with the action that fills it.

```html
<jl-card class="narrow" heading="Webhooks" description="Send events to your servers as they happen.">
  <jl-empty size="sm" icon="zap" heading="No webhooks yet" description="Add an endpoint to receive events such as payments and sign-ups.">
    <jl-button variant="primary" icon="plus" label="Add endpoint"></jl-button>
  </jl-empty>
</jl-card>
```
